LIMITED TIME CODE (x3 SPINS AND 500 CASH): BUGSFIXED

Camo or Snipe is a game similar to hide & seek, but with a twist. Hiders camouflage themselves in their surroundings, while seekers use sniper rifles to track them down and eliminate them!

🦎 Hiders: Blend into the environment to avoid being spotted by the snipers. If a hider is found, they will be eliminated.

🔫 Snipers: Search for hiders who are camouflaged in the surroundings. Look for subtle hints of movement or any mistakes made by the hiders.

Tags: Sniper, FPS, Hide and Seek, Camo, Props
